patterns.summary: ESLint 9 adopts flat configuration and removes support assumptions used by many legacy configs.
patterns.guidance: Check eslint.config.* and every shared config/plugin for flat-config support before merging.

patterns.summary: ESLint 10 removes FlatESLint and LegacyESLint exports used by older tooling.
patterns.guidance: Coordinate @eslint/js and typescript-eslint versions and run the repository lint command.

patterns.summary: The plugin becomes ESM-only, uses a named export, and changes configs.vite to a function.
patterns.guidance: Update imports/config calls and rename customHOCs to extraHOCs where used.

patterns.summary: Framework-specific Jest presets frequently lag Jest majors.
patterns.guidance: Check preset peer ranges and run tests through the framework preset.

patterns.summary: TypeScript majors can invalidate compiler options, declaration emit, and build-tool integrations.
patterns.guidance: Run typecheck, declaration emit when applicable, and the production build.

patterns.summary: TypeScript 6 deprecates baseUrl and node module resolution defaults and changes automatic type-package inclusion behavior.
patterns.guidance: Remove unnecessary baseUrl, select the repository-appropriate modern moduleResolution (often bundler), declare required type packages explicitly when typeRoots relied on automatic inclusion, and run typecheck plus the production build.

patterns.summary: Prettier majors may produce repository-wide formatting changes.
patterns.guidance: Run the check-only formatting command and inspect plugin compatibility.

patterns.summary: Kysely 0.29 removed migration-table exports imported by older better-auth Kysely adapters; typecheck may pass while an esbuild bundle fails.
patterns.guidance: For server bundles, run the real bundle build. Better Auth 1.6.20+ supports Kysely 0.29. When testing pin removal with Bun, verify the lockfile actually re-resolved and only the intended Kysely copy is bundled.
patterns.appliesWhen: The server bundle contains Kysely or an older better-auth Kysely adapter; not a client-only Expo/Metro app without Kysely.

patterns.summary: A declaration-emit regression breaks bundled client plugins and removes inferred plugin members.
patterns.guidance: Upgrade to 1.6.28+ after the repository's minimum-release-age window and validate the client typecheck.

patterns.summary: Electrobun 2 projects application APIs into .hutch/devkit via sync and its generated configuration needs TypeScript 7 compatibility adjustments.
patterns.guidance: Run electrobun sync before typecheck, ignore generated output, extend its tsconfig, use electrobunViteAliases for external Vite builds, preserve build.mainProcess=bun plus the Bun entrypoint as the lowest-risk v1 bridge when applicable, select the existing package manager in hutch.config.ts, and verify ES2021+ libs plus a baseUrl=null override for the generated TypeScript 7 config.

patterns.summary: React and react-dom must remain on compatible, normally identical, versions.
patterns.guidance: Inspect both manifest and resolved lockfile versions; validate them as a coordinated update.

patterns.summary: The constructor becomes createMMKV and delete becomes remove.
patterns.guidance: Migrate API calls and provide the Nitro Modules-compatible test mock required by the project.

patterns.summary: Expo SDKs constrain a coordinated set of package versions that can change across SDK point releases.
patterns.guidance: Run CI=1 npx expo install --check against the exact installed SDK. Check the current SDK metadata instead of hardcoding historical pins.

patterns.summary: An Expo SDK major is a coordinated platform migration rather than an ordinary package bump.
patterns.guidance: Use expo install --fix, expo-doctor, and validate config plugins/native changes; do not auto-merge as a standalone dependency bump.

patterns.summary: Expo presets and Expo packages are versioned with the SDK and may not be independently bumpable.
patterns.guidance: Run Expo compatibility checks and test the actual framework preset.

patterns.summary: React Navigation packages often require coordinated major updates.
patterns.guidance: Inspect every @react-navigation package and validate navigation tests/runtime startup.

patterns.summary: Some extensions drop default exports while extension-text-style consolidates related extensions.
patterns.guidance: Use named imports for affected extensions and run the editor build/tests; do not assume all Tiptap imports changed.

patterns.summary: Plugin React 6 requires Vite 8 and changes its underlying refresh toolchain.
patterns.guidance: Coordinate the Vite major and run the production build; do not merge a standalone incompatible bump.

patterns.summary: A Renovate Expo group may omit React and React Native packages pinned by the new SDK while CI remains green.
patterns.guidance: Run expo-doctor, align with expo install --fix, and validate the complete SDK package set.

patterns.summary: expo-module-scripts may lag the SDK and pull a Jest preset with old React Native peer expectations; different package managers can hoist it differently.
patterns.guidance: Validate using the CI package manager and add the current SDK's jest-expo explicitly when the root test preset otherwise disappears.

patterns.summary: Django majors remove deprecated middleware, URL, and framework behavior.
patterns.guidance: Read the official release notes and run framework checks plus tests.

patterns.summary: SQLAlchemy 2 changes the query and execution APIs.
patterns.guidance: Follow the official migration guide and exercise database integration tests.

patterns.summary: An update outside a consumer's declared peer range is incompatible until the consumer moves.
patterns.guidance: Inspect resolved peer constraints; coordinate updates, defer, or close with the exact incompatible range.

patterns.summary: One breaking member makes a grouped dependency update unsafe as a whole.
patterns.guidance: Validate the group together or ask the dependency bot to split it.

patterns.summary: A Gemfile.lock update can leave release tooling without the newly locked gem even when JavaScript CI remains green.
patterns.guidance: Run bundle install in the validation worktree and a repository-relevant bundle exec smoke command such as Rake tasks or Fastlane lanes.
